tasks.subject: Task 1: harvest_lookup.py — paginated project/task lookup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bundled command to find a Harvest project + tasks by code/name across every harvest_assignments*.json page (the pagination that caused the NLS-CR202 miss).

**Files:** Create scripts/harvest_lookup.py, tests/test_harvest_lookup.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** NLS-CR202 -> project 48084036 task 20753151 billable; searches all pages de-duped; exact-code first then code/name fragment; --task/--mcp-dir/--json; non-zero exit on no match.

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_harvest_lookup.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/harvest_lookup.py", "tests/test_harvest_lookup.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_harvest_lookup.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["NLS-CR202 returns project 48084036 task 20753151 billable", "searches all pages de-duped", "exact-code first; fragment on code or name", "--task/--mcp-dir/--json flags", "non-zero exit on no match"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: activity_timeline.py — categorized window timeline + zoom
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Bundled script rendering the day's window activity as merged AW-category-tagged spans + per-category rollup, with --window zoom adding web-watcher detail. Replaces the throwaway binning script.

**Files:** Create scripts/activity_timeline.py, tests/test_activity_timeline.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** categorize() returns matching class labels; build_window_spans merges same-category <60s, tags uncategorized, flags multi, drops <5s; default prints spans + per-category rollup; --window adds firefox+chrome web rows; stdlib only, --utc-offset/--json.

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_activity_timeline.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/activity_timeline.py", "tests/test_activity_timeline.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_activity_timeline.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["categorize returns matching class labels", "build_window_spans merges same-category <60s, flags multi, drops <5s", "default prints spans + per-category rollup", "--window adds firefox+chrome web rows", "stdlib only; --utc-offset/--json"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Per-monitor screenshot capture
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Capture one readable PNG per monitor (_mN.png) instead of one stitched ultra-wide image; setup script installs mss.

**Files:** Modify scripts/screenshot_capture.py, scripts/setup_screenshot_pipeline.ps1:45-52; Create tests/test_screenshot_capture.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** order_monitors() left-to-right excluding mss virtual[0]; one PNG per monitor native res; laptop-only -> single _m1.png; setup installs mss; capture.log preserved.

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_screenshot_capture.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/screenshot_capture.py", "scripts/setup_screenshot_pipeline.ps1", "tests/test_screenshot_capture.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_screenshot_capture.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["order_monitors left-to-right excludes virtual[0]", "one PNG per monitor _mN.png native res", "laptop-only -> single _m1.png", "setup installs mss", "capture.log logging preserved"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire new tools into SKILL.md
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update SKILL.md to use activity_timeline.py, harvest_lookup.py, per-monitor screenshots; fix file list + reading guidance.

**Files:** Modify SKILL.md

**Acceptance Criteria:** Step 2/3 run activity_timeline.py; Step 4 AW category = first-pass client signal (verify, not 100%, not project-level); Step 5 --window disambiguation first; screenshot section documents _mN per-monitor; file list + lookup refs harvest_lookup.py; AW-classes maintenance note incl CON2005 caveat.

**Verify:** grep -n "activity_timeline.py|harvest_lookup.py|_m1.png" SKILL.md
